enrichment.headline: Moves $12,080 at Leadership Public School Oakland R&D from equipment to a career partnership
enrichment.summary: The board is changing the 2024-2025 budget for Leadership Public School Oakland R&D, which is paid for by Measures N and H. A $14,421.89 digital products design equipment line is cut by $12,080 to $2,341.89, and an existing $11,000 Career Launch Partnership, which connects industry professionals with students, goes up by $12,080 to $23,080. The text shows money moved within the existing budget, not new money.

enrichment.headline: Hires NV5 Consultants for up to $239,800 to advise on district solar projects
enrichment.summary: The district is hiring NV5 Consultants, Inc. to provide renewable energy owner's advisory services for the district's Phase 2 and 3 solar (photovoltaic, or PV) projects, as described in Exhibit A of the agreement. The contract is capped at $239,800. Work is scheduled to start September 26, 2024 and last until June 30, 2026.

enrichment.headline: Adds $5,585.71 to Building Block Interiors' office furniture order for the Central Office move
enrichment.summary: This amendment adds 14 workstations and five panels, installed and set up for immediate use, to the district's existing purchase agreement with Building Block Interiors, Inc. for the Central Office Consolidation Move Project. It adds $5,585.71, raising the cap from $57,625 to $63,210.71, and extends the end date from August 31, 2024 to December 31, 2024 (an additional 122 days).
